smiley.bio: Toronto rapper Smiley is an OVO Sound artist known for a distinctive laid-back cadence, gritty street narratives and an unconventional vocal style that helped make him one of the city's most recognizable contemporary rappers.

softcult.bio: Kitchener twin-sister duo Softcult blends grunge, shoegaze, riot grrrl and alternative rock in a heavy, melodic sound shaped by DIY production and outspoken social themes.

solitair.bio: Toronto rapper and producer Solitair is a foundational figure in Canadian hip-hop whose work as an MC, songwriter and producer helped shape major records by Kardinal Offishall, Choclair, Jully Black and others.

sonreal.bio: Vernon, British Columbia-born rapper and singer SonReal built a Canadian hip-hop career around melodic songwriting, energetic performances and an alternative-rap sound influenced by classic East Coast hip-hop.

souldecision.bio: Vancouver pop trio soulDecision combined pop, R&B and dance production in a late-1990s and early-2000s catalogue led by Canadian chart hits including Faded.

stars.bio: Montréal-based Canadian band Stars helped define the 2000s indie-pop scene with lush chamber-pop arrangements, boy-girl vocal interplay, electronic undercurrents and emotionally detailed songwriting.

state of shock.bio: Vancouver rock band State of Shock broke nationally with melodic alternative-rock and pop-rock records including Money Honey, building a Canadian catalogue around big hooks and radio-ready guitar music.

stabilo.bio: Maple Ridge, British Columbia rock band Stabilo built a Canadian acoustic-rock and alternative catalogue around dual vocalists, melodic songwriting and radio hits including Everybody and Flawed Design.

stereos.bio: Edmonton pop-rock band Stereos blends pop, electronic and hip-hop influences in a high-energy sound that broke nationally after the group appeared on MuchMusic's disBAND.

storry.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter and visual artist STORRY is a multidisciplinary Canadian performer whose genre-fluid work moves through R&B, soul, opera, reggae and independent conceptual storytelling.
